flagged.title: Cattle's End, the Range Wars and Frontier Law and Order
flagged.reason: The video states that the Johnson County invaders were tried by a packed jury and acquitted, whereas the case never reached a jury and charges were dropped due to prosecution costs.

mark_affecting.quote: Back in court, the cattle barons packed the jury with friendly faces they'd paid for, and every single defendant was acquitted. (Also on slide at 05:32: 'Cavalry saves gunmen, jury acquits')
